clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Narache, Seer Ravenfeather prepares another Earth Sapta when a young shaman loses the brew before completing the rite. The draught opens a novice’s sight to the spirits of stone and lets the trial continue.

Young shaman begin by learning to sense forces beyond ordinary sight. To meet Mulgore’s earth elementals, an initiate drinks a sapta, a ritual brew made with natural essences of stone and soil. The Earth Sapta lifts the veil between the physical and spiritual realms, letting a novice see and commune with the spirits of the land.

A novice may lose or spill the brew before reaching the stone monument for communion. Seer Ravenfeather waits at Camp Narache and prepares another vessel when a pupil needs one. With the draught restored, the novice can continue the rite and face the spirits.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take this and remember, it is sacred.
